remaining_concerns: No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided after the initial report; the Actor narrowed and clarified the same evidentiary record.

final_rationale: The Actor response improves precision but does not add evidence. It concedes the same central gap identified initially: the auditor still cannot verify that the certification artifact actually contains the required disclosure. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes exposure. The record continues to indicate no approved mitigation, so disclosure is not a minor caveat; it is the operative compliance condition. Because that condition is still unsupported by admissible documentary evidence available to this role, the case does not move to compliant_with_caveats. At the same time, the narrowed position is more defensible than a clean-certification claim, so the proper conclusion remains suspicious rather than noncompliant: the claim could become compliant if the missing disclosure artifact were produced, but that has not been shown here.
